agentResult.response:
### Laporan Eksekusi Coding Agent — TASK-005

#### 1. Ringkasan Evaluasi & Audit Pengujian (Role: TESTING)
Audit terhadap implementasi fitur Product API pada project [`be-golang-app`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/be-golang-app/task-005-20260826t060559z-7f0730a2) telah diselesaikan:

- **Domain Layer** ([`internal/core/domain/product.go`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/be-golang-app/task-005-20260826t060559z-7f0730a2/internal/core/domain/product.go)):
  - Struct `Product` meng-embed `BaseEntity` dengan atribut `Name`, `Price`, dan `Quantity`.
  - Interface `ProductRepository` dan implementasi GORM repository mencakup operasi `Create`, `FindAll`, `FindByID`, dan `Delete`.
- **Usecase Layer** ([`internal/core/usecase/product/`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/be-golang-app/task-005-20260826t060559z-7f0730a2/internal/core/usecase/product)):
  - DTO request/response terdefinisi di [`dto.go`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/be-golang-app/task-005-20260826t060559z-7f0730a2/internal/core/usecase/product/dto.go).
  - Business logic dan validasi input (nama wajib, harga/kuantitas non-negatif) terdefinisi di [`usecase.go`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/be-golang-app/task-005-20260826t060559z-7f0730a2/internal/core/usecase/product/usecase.go).
  - Test suite lengkap di [`usecase_test.go`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/be-golang-app/task-005-20260826t060559z-7f0730a2/internal/core/usecase/product/usecase_test.go) mencakup skenario sukses, validasi negatif/empty data, dan repository error handling.
- **Controller Layer** ([`internal/adapter/controller/`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/be-golang-app/task-005-20260826t060559z-7f0730a2/internal/adapter/controller)):
  - HTTP handlers (`Create`, `List`, `Delete`) terdefinisi di [`product.go`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/be-golang-app/task-005-20260826t060559z-7f0730a2/internal/adapter/controller/product.go).
  - Unit test lengkap di [`product_test.go`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/be-golang-app/task-005-20260826t060559z-7f0730a2/internal/adapter/controller/product_test.go) dengan mock usecase menguji status HTTP 200, 201, 400, 404, dan 500.
- **Routing & AutoMigrate** ([`cmd/api/api.go`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/be-golang-app/task-005-20260826t060559z-7f0730a2/cmd/api/api.go)):
  - `ProductController` terdaftar pada router grup API dan entity terdaftar pada auto-migration database.

---

#### 2. File Berubah
- **Tidak ada file yang diubah** (`allowed_paths: []`, `requires_changes: false` untuk node verifikasi/audit).

---

#### 3. Rekomendasi Verifikasi (Diserahkan ke Orchestrator)
1. `go test ./...`
2. `go vet ./...`

---

#### 4. Retrospective Knowledge
- **Classification**: `PROJECT_ONLY` / `IGNORE`
- **Alasan**: Pengujian dan verifikasi struktur Clean Architecture bersifat spesifik implementasi project `be-golang-app` dan tidak memperkenalkan pattern arsitektural global baru yang memerlukan perubahan pada wiki knowledge base.
